title: 봉제 용 다리
description: 장난감 왕국의 저녁, 거대한 봉제 용이 지키는 나무 다리를 건너는 파란 망토 병정과 장난감 행렬 사이 다섯 가지 변화를 찾아냅니다.
theme: 장난감 왕국 대모험 — 봉제 용 다리의 저녁 행렬
scene: A magical early-evening crossing in the same handcrafted toy kingdom, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle like a premium tabletop diorama. A broad arched bridge made from warm wooden building blocks spans a narrow ribbon-blue stream through the center. Behind the bridge, one enormous friendly patchwork plush dragon curls protectively around the far tower; its nearest oversized horn at upper center is bright sunflower yellow, fully isolated against the pale lavender sky. At lower left, the recurring small wooden soldier in a rich cobalt-blue cloth cape leads the procession and carries one large cream round shield bearing one simple vivid-turquoise heart emblem. At upper right, exactly three large round coral-red paper lanterns hang in one straight horizontal row beneath a wooden arch, clearly separated with empty space between them. At lower right, a little natural-wood pull wagon carries blank toy parcels; its nearest oversized wheel is a solid vivid-turquoise disk, fully visible. Near center-right, one large coral-red triangular pennant flies alone from a short antique-gold pole on the bridge tower. Add a plush bear traveler, wooden peg-doll citizens, a tin bird, felt reeds, round stepping beads, tiny blank gift blocks, and ribbon streamers only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the yellow dragon horn, turquoise shield heart, three red lanterns, turquoise wagon wheel, and triangular pennant large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, logos, or clock numerals.
